responsibility: Defines the main rs6000 target option table and target variables. It declares ISA flag bits, processor and tuning selections, ABI- and scheduler-related variables, feature toggles such as Altivec/VSX/HTM/MMA/PCREL/prefixed addressing, code-generation tuning flags, stack-protector and split behavior, and rs6000-specific params, supplying the option metadata that drives command-line parsing and target option state for the backend.
same_name_distinction: Within the core rs6000 group, this is the target option table: it declares rs6000 command-line switches, enums, and saved variables for ISA and tuning state, rather than implementing backend behavior (rs6000.cc), declaring target macros/types (rs6000.h), or describing RTL instructions (rs6000.md).
